cohort: The study included data on 1607 admissions of newborns to hospitals across Jamaica during a 3-month period.
finding: Prematurity, multiple gestation, macrosomia, maternal diabetes, maternal hypertension, and low 5 minute Apgar score < 7 were independent predictors of neonatal admission.
mod_finding: Infants born via caesarean section were 2.1 times more likely to be admitted compared to those born by other modes.
